atAGlance: Nấm kho tiêu is mushrooms braised with black pepper and soy-caramel depth, a compact vegetarian dish made for rice.
whatItIs: Nấm kho tiêu is a chay kho dish where mushrooms replace meat as the savory center. Pepper, soy, and caramelized aromatics make the mushrooms taste deep and glossy.
howToEnjoy: Spoon the mushrooms and glaze over rice, then add herbs or greens for freshness. Ask about fish sauce if you need strict vegetarian cooking.
howLocalsOrder: Nấm kho tiêu is a mushroom-and-pepper braise for rice, so ask for less pepper if you want the mushroom sweetness to show. Confirm chay seasoning if the restaurant also cooks meat dishes.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Nấm kho tiêu shows how vegetarian kitchens use mushrooms for depth instead of mock meat. It is small, peppery, and stronger than it looks.
goodToKnow: Ask whether the braise is fully vegetarian if needed.
travelerCaution: Ask whether the braise is fully vegetarian if needed.
